argv:
set -u
X=/tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR44-Ez7Ttp/hz; rm -rf "$X"; mkdir -p "$X"
E=.ufo/evidence/round-16/round-gate
git -C ~/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin show 364f1d5954158ef8844bca4a5fef57b05d2f2ca5:scripts/round-gate.mjs > "$X/round-gate.mjs"
sha256sum "$X/round-gate.mjs"
cnt() { git -C "$1" rev-list --all --count 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
echo "## (a) exported GIT_DIR, inherited environment (no env -i)"
git init -q "$X/victim" && git -C "$X/victim" -c user.name=v -c user.email=v@v commit -q --allow-empty -m seed
echo "victim commits before: $(cnt "$X/victim")"
mkdir -p "$X/a/home" "$X/a/tmp"
( cd "$X/a" && export GIT_DIR="$X/victim/.git" HOME="$X/a/home" TMPDIR="$X/a/tmp" && node "$X/round-gate.mjs" --selftest > "$X/a/out.txt" 2>&1; echo "selftest exit=$?" )
echo "victim commits after: $(cnt "$X/victim")"
git -C "$X/victim" log --all --format='  %s' | head -5
grep -m1 'ROUND_GATE_SELFTEST:' "$X/a/out.txt"
echo "## (a') same exported GIT_DIR, guarded suite.txt string"
git init -q "$X/victim2" && git -C "$X/victim2" -c user.name=v -c user.email=v@v commit -q --allow-empty -m seed
( export GIT_DIR="$X/victim2/.git" MUTANT="$X/round-gate.mjs" WORKDIR="$X/a2" DEFECT_ID=GUARD && bash -c "$(cat "$E/suite.txt")" > "$X/a2.out" 2>&1; echo "guarded selftest exit=$?" )
echo "victim2 commits after (seed only = 1): $(cnt "$X/victim2")"
grep -m1 'ROUND_GATE_SELFTEST:' "$X/a2.out"
echo "## (b) TMPDIR inside a git work tree, env -i without the ceiling"
git init -q "$X/wt" && mkdir -p "$X/wt/tmp" "$X/b/home"
( cd "$X/b" && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$X/b/home" TMPDIR="$X/wt/tmp" LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 node "$X/round-gate.mjs" --selftest > "$X/b/out.txt" 2>&1; echo "selftest exit=$?" )
grep -E '^\s*FAIL|ROUND_GATE_SELFTEST:' "$X/b/out.txt" | cut -c1-220
echo "## (b') sandbox inside the same work tree, guarded suite.txt string"
( export MUTANT="$X/round-gate.mjs" WORKDIR="$X/wt/work" DEFECT_ID=GUARD && bash -c "$(cat "$E/suite.txt")" > "$X/b2.out" 2>&1; echo "guarded selftest exit=$?" )
grep -m1 'ROUND_GATE_SELFTEST:' "$X/b2.out"
